races.name: Happy Birthday Mark Holton Nursery
races.verdict:
SON OF A FISH took his form up a notch when third on nursery debut at Leicester just over a fortnight ago and with better anticipated quickly returned up to 1m, Richard Hannon's colt gets the verdict. Similar comments apply to Astral Calling, so she could be the one to give the selection most to do, with Mick & David Easterby's pair Hope of Acklam and Diplomacy taken to fight out third.

  1. SON OF A FISH
  2. ASTRAL CALLING (IRE)
  3. HOPE OF ACKLAM

races.name: Weatherbys Stallion Book Nursery
races.verdict:
FLOWER YOUMZAIN may well have opened her account but for better luck at Carlisle a fortnight ago and with further progress on the cards now tackling a nursery, Kevin Ryan's filly earns the vote. Wondervision seemed unsuited by the way the race developed at Doncaster recently and better judged on her penultimate success, she heads up the dangers. Empress Princess may prove best of the rest.

  1. FLOWER YOUMZAIN (IRE)
  2. WONDERVISION (IRE)
  3. EMPRESS PRINCESS (IRE)

races.name: British EBF Supports Racing To School Future Stayers Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
The pair with racecourse experience don't set a tall standard to aim at so the newcomers look the ones to focus on, GOLDEN SOUK getting the nod to make a winning start for a yard synonymous with 2-y-o success. The Can Can Man and El Waabil are another couple of debutants to note in a novice where the market will no doubt prove informative.

  1. GOLDEN SOUK (IRE)
  2. THE CAN CAN MAN (USA)
  3. EL WAABIL

races.name: weatherbysshop.co.uk Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
POINTED shaped encouragingly on debut when fourth in an interesting-looking novice at Kempton and she can build on that effort to open her account. Sheikhnshah is feared most dropped in trip with the headgear reapplied, while Paname is one to note making his first start.

  1. POINTED (IRE)
  2. SHEIKHNSHAH (FR)
  3. PANAME (USA)

races.name: Weatherbys & Birdie Calendars Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
RIZAL had been progressing nicely for this stable before having excuses at Newmarket last month, so he is taken to leave his latest effort behind as he drops back down in distance. He gets the vote ahead of Percy's Daydream, who shaped well over C&D a fortnight ago, with Everyoneknowsadave also considered.

  1. RIZAL (FR)
  2. PERCY'S DAYDREAM
  3. EVERYONEKNOWSADAVE (IRE)

races.name: racingtv/freetrial Handicap
races.verdict:
SERGEANT MAYER comes here in fine fettle and is fancied to defy a 4 lb weights rise for his stylish Leicester success and complete a hat-trick. Veteran Ventura Express could emerge as the main danger from a reduced mark ahead of Emperor's Son.

  1. SERGEANT MAYER (IRE)
  2. VENTURA EXPRESS
  3. EMPEROR'S SON (IRE)

races.name: AJA Novice Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
races.verdict:
Preference is for SOUTH KENSINGTON who was beaten only by a thriving rival at Lingfield on her latest outing. She is fancied to gain a second win for her current yard, though the in-form Night Emperor isn't taken lightly, along with Judicature as he drops back down in grade.

  1. SOUTH KENSINGTON (IRE)
  2. NIGHT EMPEROR (IRE)
  3. JUDICATURE

races.name: Harvesting What Matters Most Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
CHICKER comfortably saw off a next-time-out winner on his hurdle debut in May and can make the most of the weight he receives from dual hurdle scorer Gambino. Jet of Stars is unbeaten in a point/bumper and could also play a leading role if the betting vibes are strong.

  1. CHICKER
  2. GAMBINO (IRE)
  3. JET OF STARS (IRE)

races.name: Lord Mansfield Memorial Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
The normally-reliable FRONTIER PRINCE had a possible excuse in the Swinton and gets a narrow vote ahead of Letterston Lily and Patrick Neville's Dolly Dior. Dan Skelton handicap newcomer Hidden Fortune is another to consider in what looks a competitive race.

  1. FRONTIER PRINCE
  2. LETTERSTON LILY
  3. DOLLY DIOR

races.name: Bet With The Dewhurst Ring Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
A competitive handicap but MAGNOLIA has slipped to a lenient mark and with her yard going well she looks the way to go on her return from a break. Last year's winner Pure Gold seems primed for a big run and rates a big danger though, while in-form duo Follow Charlie and Annie Agnew can also play prominent roles.

  1. MAGNOLIA (FR)
  2. PURE GOLD
  3. FOLLOW CHARLIE (IRE)

races.name: Paul Ferguson's Jumpers To Follow David Whitaker Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
TAMARIND BAY continues to go from strength to strength and still looks ahead of his mark despite a 9 lb hike for his facile Bangor victory so can garner success number 4 of the season for last year's winning connections. The Real Whacker could get his own way in front and rates the main danger from a career-low chase mark for his in-form yard, while the thriving Breizh River can also play a prominent role in a cracking handicap chase.

  1. TAMARIND BAY (IRE)
  2. THE REAL WHACKER (IRE)
  3. BREIZH RIVER (FR)

races.name: Thank You To Kinneston Owners Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
DELGANY SECOND NOW made a smooth transition to fences at Bangor 19 days ago and while the assessor has now been able to react, he still makes plenty of appeal with his 4-y-o allowance. He can complete a 4-timer, possibly at the expense of Roi du Roume and Didntgotwenty.

  1. DELGANY SECOND NOW
  2. ROI DU ROUME (FR)
  3. DIDNTGOTWENTY (IRE)

races.name: Nairn's Oatcakes Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
FOREST SPIRIT benefited from the step up to around 3m when narrowly denied at Worcester earlier in the month and might be able to go one place better. Two wins this summer mean Seeyainthesuninn merits plenty of respect, while C'mon So has reached the frame over C&D on his last 2 outings and should figure again. A market move for Nicky Richards handicap newcomer Luckie Devil would also bring him firmly into the reckoning.

  1. FOREST SPIRIT (IRE)
  2. SEEYAINTHESUNINN
  3. C'MON SO (IRE)

races.name: Juddmonte EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
PLEASE DON'T GO sets the standard and gets the nod with this step up in trip promising to suit on breeding but she doesn't set the bar that high so strong market confidence behind Gosden stable newcomer Henrik Ibsen would put a slightly different slant on things. Last month's 1m course fourth Fastidyah should also have more to offer now moving up in trip.

  1. PLEASE DON'T GO (IRE)
  2. HENRIK IBSEN (IRE)
  3. FASTIDYAH (IRE)

races.name: Virgin Bet Every Saturday Money Back Classified Stakes
races.verdict:
PLAID is building up a solid record and is preferred to fellow 3-y-o Runman in this useful classified stakes.

  1. PLAID
  2. RUNMAN
  3. NESTHORN

races.name: Heineken Handicap
races.verdict:
A further 2 lb ease in his mark might be enough to see STORM STAR land a first success on turf. Jimmy Speaking goes off the same mark as when narrowly denied at Yarmouth last week and is second choice ahead of Darkness, who has posted plenty of fine efforts at Goodwood.

  1. STORM STAR
  2. JIMMY SPEAKING
  3. DARKNESS (FR)

races.name: Virgin Bet Foundation Stakes (Listed)
races.verdict:
NAQEEB is 3 lb better off with Boiling Point than when pipped by him in another C&D listed event in May and is taken to land this race for the second year in succession. Treble Tee should also have a say if his stamina holds stepping up to 1¼m.

  1. NAQEEB (IRE)
  2. BOILING POINT (IRE)
  3. TREBLE TEE (IRE)

races.name: British EBF 100,000 2YO Fillies' Series Final (EBF Restricted Race Series) (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
This valuable event can go the way of James Fanshawe's TIKKA who looked an excellent prospect when scoring in fine style on her recent Kempton debut and can take this step up in class in her stride. Eabha brings some very strong Group-race form to the table and rates a big threat though. Fillipas can also play a prominent role with this step up to 7f looking a big plus, while Zigazig Ah, Lady Foxtrot and Flooding all command plenty of respect too in this cracking juvenile fillies' event.

  1. TIKKA
  2. EABHA (IRE)
  3. FILLIPAS (IRE)

races.name: Virgin Bet Daily Extra Places Fillies' Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
No shortage of chances in a competitive fillies' handicaps with QUEBELLA shading preference. Lightly raced this season, she left the distinct impression a stronger tempo would have suited when fourth at Bath 3 weeks ago and, expected to come on for that run, she looks interesting on her first crack at this trip. Hope Rising continues to go from strength-to-strength and is a lead danger in search of the 5-timer with Kissmehoneyhoney another who likely has a bigger effort in her locker.

  1. QUEBELLA
  2. HOPE RISING (IRE)
  3. KISSMEHONEYHONEY

races.name: Virgin Bet A Good Bet Handicap
races.verdict:
PERCY'S STAR came 3 lengths clear with a lightly-raced improver at Yarmouth last week and looks well treated off the same mark. George Wickham is a very interesting handicap newcomer and heads the many possible dangers along with last month's C&D scorer Sound And Vision and Tony Carroll's Serenity Dream.

  1. PERCY'S STAR
  2. GEORGE WICKHAM (IRE)
  3. SOUND AND VISION (IRE)

races.name: Unibet/EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
KODIAC CITY found the Group 3 Solario Stakes too much but had previously created a good impression at Southwell and back down in class, is fancied to defy a penalty. Newcomers will surely offer most resistance, with Playing Card and Donegan perhaps the pick of them.

  1. KODIAC CITY (IRE)
  2. PLAYING CARD (IRE)
  3. DONEGAN

races.name: Unibet/EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
PURE CONCEPT ran to a fairly useful level when finishing second in a C&D novice 4 weeks ago and this looks an excellent opportunity for Richard Hannon's colt to go one place better with improvement forthcoming. Newcomer's Beryozka and Renascent may emerge as the lead dangers in a race where most look longer term/handicap projects.

  1. PURE CONCEPT (AUS)
  2. BERYOZKA
  3. RENASCENT (IRE)

races.name: Racing TV Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
John Butler saddles 3 here and unless the market suggests otherwise regarding his 2 new inmates, PROTECTRIX looks the one to be with on handicap debut. Freda dips in class and that makes her dangerous, with Sunshine And Roses likely to remain competitive.

  1. PROTECTRIX (IRE)
  2. FREDA (IRE)
  3. SUNSHINE AND ROSES

races.name: Unibet/EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
SHOW ME GLORY makes appeal on paper and rates the type to improve on the back of her debut third in a Newmarket novice over further 33 days ago. In good hands and well drawn, she shades preference over Duchess of Immatin who has similarly shaped with promise in 2 starts to date. Newcomer Letter To Hermione makes appeal on paper and is another to note.

  1. SHOW ME GLORY (IRE)
  2. DUCHESS OF IMMATIN (IRE)
  3. LETTER TO HERMIONE

races.name: Industry Leading In-Play Markets At Unibet Handicap
races.verdict:
ICONIC DAWN produced a big career best in first-time cheekpieces when successful at Lingfield 11 days ago and in the hope the headgear works again, she's selected to follow up. Stall 10 could have been better for Methgal but he's still a threat, while Dontspoilasale will surely pop up at some point in the coming weeks on all-weather.

  1. ICONIC DAWN
  2. METHGAL (IRE)
  3. DONTSPOILASALE (IRE)

races.name: Unibet Supports Safer Gambling Handicap
races.verdict:
VICTORY SOUND ended a losing run at a lower level at Newcastle 3 weeks ago, yet he had enough in hand on that occasion to think he can be very competitive again following a token 2 lb rise and earns the vote. Spirit of Breeze highlighted his turn may be near when second at Lingfield recently and he's a major threat under David Egan. Last-time-out scorer Whitesnake remains unexposed at 1m and is another to consider despite a tricky draw.

  1. VICTORY SOUND (IRE)
  2. SPIRIT OF BREEZE (IRE)
  3. WHITESNAKE

races.name: Try Unibet's New Improved Acca Boosts Handicap
races.verdict:
This looks wide open so at the likely odds it is worth siding with CHALK MOUNTAIN, who arrives in better heart than his recent form figures suggests and can follow up his success in this event 12 months ago. In-form duo Manly Fireball and Suggy both seem sure to be on the premises, while the handily-weighted Metal Merchant and unexposed Crossbar also need factoring into this competitive handicap.

  1. CHALK MOUNTAIN
  2. MANLY FIREBALL (IRE)
  3. SUGGY

races.name: Unibet More Extra Place Races Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
A case can be made for a few of these but it's very hard to side against JOSEPH, who scored in excellent style over C&D last time and still looks ahead of his mark despite an 8 lb hike in the weights. What's The Plan should prove suited by dropping in trip here and appeals as the one to chase him home, although Aphrodite Spirit and Wardlaw can also go well.

  1. JOSEPH
  2. WHAT'S THE PLAN
  3. APHRODITE SPIRIT

races.name: Unibet 40,000+ Live Streamed Events Handicap
races.verdict:
A case can be made for lots of these but the vote goes to ARUNDEL who resumed from an absence with an encouraging Yarmouth third and can race off the same mark here with Billy Loughnane now in the saddle. Sansanetti heads the list of dangers on the back of a good Wolverhampton fourth, while Ghost Story, Kurios Lady and Ricardo Phillips can all have a say too.

  1. ARUNDEL (IRE)
  2. SANSANETTI (IRE)
  3. GHOST STORY (IRE)

races.name: McSweeney Brothers Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
LOVE ME TENDER may not have rewarded favourite backers in the Ebor last month, but Willie Mullins' German recruit shaped encouragingly and now with attentions quickly switched to hurdling, he gets the vote. Bud Fox is progressing gradually in this sphere and clearly with much more to come given his bumper form, he heads up the opposition, with Tyson Fury and Jules Winfield completing the shortlist.

  1. LOVE ME TENDER (GER)
  2. BUD FOX (IRE)
  3. TYSON FURY

races.name: Seamus Mulvaney Bookmaker Novice Hurdle
races.verdict:
BARTHOLOMEW progressed notably well in 3 juvenile hurdles for his current yard last season and is the clear pick at the weights, especially with a recent Flat run under his belt. Columbus was tailed off in the face of a stiff task back on the level at York last time but there's better still to come from him as a hurdler and he's feared most.

  1. BARTHOLOMEW
  2. COLUMBUS (GER)
  3. GOLDEN HANDSHAKE

races.name: Brandon Hotel Handicap Hurdle (0-100)
races.verdict:
ABORAS MAHLER has proved a different proposition in 2 starts this season, edged out only near the finish making handicap debut at Downpatrick, and he could still have more to offer now switched to Eric McNamara. He is the pick ahead of Lunar Landscape, who has been getting the hang of things over hurdles, with Glin Road Boy also of plenty of interest.

  1. ABORAS MAHLER (IRE)
  2. LUNAR LANDSCAPE
  3. GLIN ROAD BOY (IRE)

races.name: Devon Inn Dan Sheehan Memorial Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
COOLADDI is going the right way and is taken to reverse recent form with Smallcraftwarning and resume winning ways. Caher Roes Den won last time and rates the chief threat, with further improvement likely for Willie Mullins, while Hi Ho Idaho should be sharper for the recent outing and could improve upped in trip.

  1. COOLADDI (IRE)
  2. CAHER ROES DEN (IRE)
  3. HI HO IDAHO (IRE)

races.name: Guinness Kerry National Handicap Chase (Grade 3)
races.verdict:
NOWWHATDOYOUTHINK shaped as if ahead of his mark behind King Alexander in the Galway Plate and is taken to prove it back at 3m at a track that should suit his style of racing better. Funiculi Funicula must bounce back but Paul Townend keeps the faith and his natural class makes him a big danger if staying the 3m trip. Recent Galway winner Kings Hill remains of interest, with both Conyers Hill and Spread Boss Ted also respected.

  1. NOWWHATDOYOUTHINK (IRE)
  2. FUNICULI FUNICULA (FR)
  3. KINGS HILL (IRE)

races.name: Ballygarry Estate Hotel & Spa Mares Novice Chase
races.verdict:
LA NOTE VERTE has progressed with each start over fences and is taken to follow up her recent Tramore success. Lady Bluebird may lack the potential of some of these but has taken very well to chasing and could prove hard to peg back if allowed her own way in front. Miss Doyenne won on chase debut and remains open to improvement, though she may prove best over further.

  1. LA NOTE VERTE
  2. LADY BLUEBIRD (IRE)
  3. MISS DOYENNE (IRE)

races.name: Paul Moynihan (Ex VFI President) Memorial Flat Race
races.verdict:
ROND POINT showed promise in a race that's working out well at Galway in July and is taken to become the latest to frank that form by making his second start under Rules a winning one. New Grange, a winner of his sole outing in points, is a notable Rules newcomer and needs taking very seriously, especially if the market vibes are strong. Back In Favour is sure to be suited by this step up in trip and is also feared.

  1. ROND POINT
  2. NEW GRANGE (IRE)
  3. BACK IN FAVOUR (IRE)

races.name: Hollywoodbets Durbanville Welcomes You Maiden Plate (F & M)
races.verdict:
CAPTAIN'S ELECT isn't easy to look past. Jack A Dandy could have the most to offer of the remainder, while Eyecatcher might be best of the rest.

  1. CAPTAIN'S ELECT (SAF)
  2. JACK A DANDY (SAF)
  3. EYECATCHER (SAF)

races.name: Lucky Fish Gates Of Olympus Maiden Plate (F & M)
races.verdict:
LADY SUNSHINE could be the one they have to beat. Virginia Bluebell is another who may have a big say in proceedings, while African Kingfisher is not out of it where the places are concerned.

  1. LADY SUNSHINE (SAF)
  2. VIRGINIA BLUEBELL (SAF)
  3. AFRICAN KINGFISHER

races.name: Join The Race Coast Turf Club Maiden Plate
races.verdict:
TIME OF OUR LIVES gets the vote in an open race. Disco Jet should be in the mix, while Magic Rock comes into calculations for minor honours.

  1. TIME OF OUR LIVES (SAF)
  2. DISCO JET (SAF)
  3. MAGIC ROCK (SAF)

races.name: Racing Club Syndicate Maiden Plate
races.verdict:
BIG CITY ROLLER appeals as the likeliest winner here. Cracker is dangerous, while Cardinal King can scrap it out for third.

  1. BIG CITY ROLLER (SAF)
  2. CRACKER (SAF)
  3. CARDINAL KING (SAF)

races.name: Join The Passion Apprentice Class 5
races.verdict:
FINAL CALL can come out on top. Shifting Path is not one to underestimate however, while Kliptown also commands a closer look.

  1. FINAL CALL (SAF)
  2. SHIFTING PATH (SAF)
  3. KLIPTOWN (SAF)

races.name: Lucky Fish Diamond Riches Class 4 (F & M)
races.verdict:
AMAYAH has sound claims. Beneath The Clouds is another who should take a hand, while Miss Attitude deserves respect as well.

  1. AMAYAH (SAF)
  2. BENEATH THE CLOUDS (SAF)
  3. MISS ATTITUDE (SAF)

races.name: Race Coast Incentives Powered By Hollywoodbets Class 4
races.verdict:
CAPTAINS ALLIANCE gets a narrow vote. Signor Dante looks the best option for the forecast, while Man Of Consequence might be worth siding with for third.

  1. CAPTAINS ALLIANCE (SAF)
  2. SIGNOR DANTE (SAF)
  3. MAN OF CONSEQUENCE (SAF)

races.name: Hollywoodbets Bright Future Class 5
races.verdict:
WARRIOR OF DESTINY can win again. Devil A Saint should play a leading role, while Fortune One also commands a second look.

  1. WARRIOR OF DESTINY (SAF)
  2. DEVIL A SAINT (SAF)
  3. FORTUNE ONE (SAF)
